findings: Fresh v0.1.64 capture: supported Poky 6.0.2 linux-yocto do_compile held the eight-logical-CPU host at 99.8393% trimmed-mean utilization over 360 seconds after a ten-second warmup in the isolated offline build directory.

Daemon plus one attached client consumed 0.9333% of one logical CPU. Keyboard-to-frame p95 was 4.6814 ms, cancellation acknowledgement 4.8349 ms, and fresh attach 21.9319 ms. No backend disconnect, critical delivery pressure, or resynchronization occurred.

The build-source patch contains only candidate version and compatible lru security-update changes relative to e737802. Runtime source hashes identify the actual measured application; earlier v0.1.61 records remain historical evidence in Git and the logger report.
No normal user build configuration, running daemon or active user job was changed. The private fixture uses eight build threads and make jobs, offline downloads and an isolated writable sstate cache.
All pre-existing CPU, latency, continuity and memory thresholds are unchanged.
